title: A top-dimensional current with integrable integer density, locally constant where nonzero, is integer multiplicity
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (m + 1)) (v : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ), Measurable v → Integrable v → (∀ x, ∃ k : ℤ, v x = k) → (∀ x, v x ≠ 0 → ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, v y = v x) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (m + 1), T ω = ∫ x, v x * (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) → IsIntegerMultiplicity T
